description: AirHistory.net records it photographed at Kinshasa N'Djili in 2007, notes it was modified to GB standard and possibly in storage, and states that around 2014 it was preserved at the base; spottingmode.com independently lists it as preserved and gives the same construction number 6618, though it records the type as MB-326GB rather than K. Two contributor communities therefore agree on airframe identity and on preservation. Recorded as a K because the AirHistory caption explains the discrepancy - the airframe was built as a K and modified to GB standard. Sits within the walled air force compound set back from Boulevard Lumumba; the object at the recorded position in the 3 June 2022 Esri imagery is in deep shadow and could not be resolved to type from satellite alone.
